title: Large bundle size with ES module
body:
### 🐛 Current behavior I have just created a new Svelte project using Vite. Created a super simple page without any templating and no added widgets. Thre result is a large bundle size that includes alot of unused packages. ![main\_full (2)](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/7306904/208679088-8d7469ab-8d35-4d70-a77a-45998a46d70b.png) Some examples of unused code (maybe?): * Hogan.js * @algolia/events * all connectors in the picture * all components in the picture See this for rollup: https://codesandbox.io/s/dawn-waterfall-sbvly9?file=/index.html I think the reason for this is because of inproper imports. Examples: * https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/master/packages/instantsearch.js/src/lib/InstantSearch.ts#L2 * https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/master/packages/instantsearch.js/src/lib/InstantSearch.ts#L3 ### 🔍 Steps to reproduce ``` $ npm init vite $ cd new-vite-project $ yarn add algoliasearch instantsearch.js ``` init instantsearch without adding any widgets ```

EMPTY PAGE

``` ### Live reproduction https://codesandbox.io/s/dawn-waterfall-sbvly9?file=/index.html ### 💭 Expected behavior Hogan.js should not be bundled and the same with unused connectors, widgets and templates. ### Package version algoliasearch 4.14.3, instantsearch.js 4.49.2, vite 4.0.0, svelte 3.54.0 ### Operating system Ubuntu ### Browser Chrome ### Code of Conduct * \[X] I agree to follow this project's Code of Conduct
